# Enough Python to be dangerous

Seven chapters, and none of them are about Python.

They are about sequences, and Python is how we handle them. Nearly every example
is a piece of DNA, a codon table, or a file somebody really sent somebody else,
and the one that is none of those is your own time budget. Anything this book
does not use later is not in here.

Chapter 16 is the one that matters most. It is about reading error messages,
and it is the difference between a person who is learning to program and a
person who has quit.
